description: One of: create, list, update, pause, resume, remove, run, cancel. When action=create, the 'schedule' and 'prompt' fields are REQUIRED.
action_description: 'run' fires a job immediately in the BACKGROUND (returns a handle at once, outcome re-enters the conversation when done — do not wait or poll; optional 'prompt' adds transient context for that fire only)

action.description: One of: create, list, update, pause, resume, remove, run, cancel. When action=create, the 'schedule' and 'prompt' fields are REQUIRED.

prompt.description: For create/update: the full self-contained prompt (when it runs goes in 'schedule'; data windows like 'since yesterday' stay here; paired with any skills as the task instruction). For run: optional transient context for that single fire (never persisted).

schema_derivation: derived from the shared schema plus the final-head handler; not an upstream per-action schema
